title: Agents reversed fewer correct judgments when they recorded evidence before feedback
summary: Across 75 passing draft evaluations, five Gemini models reversed a correct decision in 41 standard trials and 34 trials when the models wrote a claim checklist after feedback. The full pre-feedback checklist condition recorded 9 reversals. The test used a fixed set of deliberately mistaken critiques.
ai_technology: Gemini language models; controlled claim and feedback ordering

source_review.scope: v1 controlled Turn-2 report review, §4.3 Table 3 and evaluation limits

evidence.tested: A controlled report-review study compared the order of evidential self-assessment and feedback, with 20 scenarios per model and separate cases containing valid correction.
evidence.unknown: Scenario and model dependence matter: the same scenarios were reused and the benchmark uses selected passing or flawed drafts.
evidence.ai_role: Five Gemini models reevaluated their reports, with the timing of recording earlier claims varied around identical mistaken criticism.
